initial_application: FHIR-15579 required no independent source edit. Its resolution cites FHIR-15583 as approving entered-in-error for CarePlan.activity.detail.status. additional_context: The current CarePlan source is active in source/fhir.ini. The historical CarePlan.activity.detail.status field now appears as CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail.status and still has isModifier true with a modifier reason tied to entered-in-error. The CarePlan activity status CodeSystem includes entered-in-error and the ValueSet includes that CodeSystem.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already reflects the no-change decision by keeping the activity status modifier and including entered-in-error.
